rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice when a process or advance cannot be stopped or prevented.

example.english: Online shopping spread inexorably, so traditional shops had to transform.
example.traditional: 網購擋唔住咁普及開去，傳統舖頭唯有轉型。
example.jyutping: mong5 kau3 dong2 m4 zyu6 gam3 pou2 kap6 hoi1 heoi3 cyun4 tung2 pou3 tau2 wai4 jau5 zyun2 jing4

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on something continuing without stopping, especially a movement or gradual advance.

example.english: The tide rose inexorably, slowly covering the steps.
example.traditional: 潮水不斷咁漲，慢慢浸過石級。
example.jyutping: ciu4 seoi2 bat1 dyun6 gam3 zoeng3 maan6 maan2 zam3 gwo3 sek6 kap1
